meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源并生成可用资源快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在运行资源敏感任务前了解可用CPU、内存和磁盘限制
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resources and generate a usable resource snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know available CPU, memory, and disk limits before running resource-sensitive tasks

howto.what: 安装后，当用户提出资源密集型任务时，Claude 会自动检测并报告 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等可用资源，然后给出并行处理、内存策略、GPU 加速等计算方式建议，并生成 JSON 文件供后续使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理大数据集、训练模型或进行并行计算等资源密集型任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个50GB的基因组数据
say.note: 触发资源检测，判断是否需要Dask等分布式处理。

say.text: 在我的机器上训练一个神经网络
say.note: 触发GPU可用性检测，推荐后端库。
触发CPU核心数检测，建议最佳并行工作数。

howto.what_en: After installation, when the user proposes a resource-intensive task, Claude automatically detects and reports available CPU, GPU, memory, disk resources, then suggests strategies for parallel processing, memory management, GPU acceleration, etc., and generates a JSON file for further use.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests handling large datasets, training models, or performing parallel computation that is resource-intensive.

say_en.text: Analyze this 50GB genomics dataset for me
say_en.note: Triggers resource detection to decide if Dask/Zarr is needed.

say_en.text: Train a neural network on my machine
say_en.note: Triggers GPU detection and backend recommendation.
Triggers CPU core detection and optimal worker count suggestion.
